Nesha Leesha is a Baldur's Gate citizen. She is waiting for a friend to join her at the Blushing Mermaid tavern.
“
This place certainly has an interesting… aroma to it.
„
— Nesha Leesha, waiting for her acquaintance

Involvement

Nesha Leesha is standing on the open terrace near the Blushing Mermaid at X: -145 Y: -96; she may sometimes walk a couple of meters to the west. Nesha is a bit nervous and her banter lines reveal that she is visiting the establishment for the first time. When the party approach her, Nesha tells them that a friend invited her for a drink but has not arrived yet.

Nesha Leesha is one of the marked targets listed on the  Bloodstained Parchment, those who seek to become an Unholy Assassin of  Bhaal must kill two targets from the list. When the party reaches Act Three locations, she is still alive. Her name is included in the list alongside those of  Cora Highberry,  Chef Roveer, and  Figaro Pennygood, the other living victims.

If the player character tells Nesha that her name is on the serial killer's list, she does not believe them at first. To convince her, they must pass an ability check:

  • [PERSUASION]  Please listen to me. Others have died already, you are in danger. (DC 15)

On a successful check, Nesha becomes frightened and runs away.[1]  +1  +1  +1  -1

If the player character decides to become an Unholy Assassin by completing Impress the Murder Tribunal, they can tell Nesha that they intend to kill her. This turns Nesha and all nearby tavern personnel and clients temporarily hostile, except several Tipplesome Patrons inside the tavern and its owner Captain Grisly. Those characters remain neutral unless attacked.[2]

Notable loot

  • Nesha's Hand, which can be used to gain access to the Murder Tribunal
  • Potion of Speed
  • Potion of Invisibility
